newsitem.title: USA: New York Times December advertising rises.
newsitem.headline: New York Times December advertising rises.

text.p: New York Times Co said Monday its total advertising volume for its New York Times newspaper rose seven percent in December but was down for the year by 1.1 percent.
For the fourth quarter, advertising volume at the company's flagship newspaper was up 1.4 percent.
At the Boston Globe newspaper, advertising volume was up 14.7 percent in December, up 4.2 percent in the fourth quarter and up modestly by 0.7 percent for the year.
Ad volume at the company's Regional Newspaper Group was down 2.3 percent in December and up 0.2 percent for the year.
For the fourth quarter, ad volume at the group was up two percent.
